_comment: Noora Health Bangladesh RES preset (the translated message-level dataset). The speaker values below are placeholders: run inspect_export.py and copy the real values of the `role` column into speaker_labels and assistant_speakers before building items.

workshop.name: Noora Health Bangladesh RES Labeling Workshop

translation.context: WhatsApp messages between patients and nurses on a maternal health support service in Bangladesh

task.name: Noora Health Bangladesh RES Labeling Workshop 2
task.description: Read each WhatsApp conversation between a patient and a Noora nurse (Bangla with an English translation) and answer every question for the conversation as a whole.

judge.subject: a conversation between a nurse and a patient
judge.context: The context is Noora Health's Remote Engagement Services, where nurses answer patients' questions over WhatsApp in Bangladesh.
judge.message_format: Each message shows the speaker, then the original Bangla text and its English translation.
judge.focus: Judge the nurse's response(s) across the whole conversation.
